messages.subject: HX unit recall - Stratton framework, LDs and rebate
messages.plaintextBody:
Gavin,

Following the recall notice, Stratton's procurement and legal have confirmed we will be applying the late/defective delivery LDs under clause 11 of the framework and the quality-breach rebate under schedule 4. Our calculation comes to £275,000 LDs and £150,000 rebate. We appreciate Harrow is pursuing the foundry; this doesn't change our position under the framework but we're content for the figures to be shared with your solicitors.

Robert Pearce, Head of Procurement, Stratton Energy plc
